2025-09-30.riddle: I’m invisible yet can be felt. I can knock down trees but also cool your face. What am I?
2025-09-30.hint: You can hear me whistle but never see me.

2025-10-01.riddle: I climb without legs, I fall without fear. I crash with a roar but leave nothing to hold. What am I?
2025-10-01.hint: I rise and fall at the shore.

2025-10-02.riddle: I hide behind clouds but never leave the sky. I change my face but never my place. What am I?
2025-10-02.hint: I wax and wane each month.

2025-10-03.riddle: I can cut without steel, whisper without a voice, and travel faster than feet. What am I?
2025-10-03.hint: You feel me on your skin, not in your hand.

2025-10-04.riddle: I carry letters without ink, fly without wings, and wait in a box until opened. What am I?
2025-10-04.hint: You find me in the mailbox.

2025-10-05.riddle: I’m covered in numbers, yet I’m not a book. I can count your days but not your steps. What am I?
2025-10-05.hint: I hang on walls and track the year.

2025-10-06.riddle: I vanish when spoken, fragile as breath. I can be broken by a single word. What am I?
2025-10-06.hint: You can hear me only when I’m gone.

2025-10-07.riddle: I move without legs, shimmer without light, and curl into shapes both tiny and vast. What am I?
2025-10-07.hint: I rise from fire in twisting trails.

2025-10-08.riddle: I grow without roots, shine without flame, and guide travelers through the night. What am I?
2025-10-08.hint: I sparkle above in the sky.

2025-10-09.riddle: I’m held in your hand but I’m not alive. With a flick I burst into flame. What am I?
2025-10-09.hint: Strike me once and I disappear in fire.

2025-10-10.riddle: I have a face that never smiles, two hands that never hold. Yet I’m trusted every day. What am I?
2025-10-10.hint: I mark every second of your life.

2025-10-11.riddle: I fall without a sound, blanket the ground, and vanish under the sun. What am I?
2025-10-11.hint: I arrive in winter, one of many.

2025-10-12.riddle: I am broken every morning but whole every night. What am I?
2025-10-12.hint: You rest inside me, then leave me with the dawn.

2025-10-13.riddle: I cross rivers without bridges, climb mountains without legs, and fill valleys without hands. What am I?
2025-10-13.hint: I roll in and out, hiding the view.

2025-10-14.riddle: I mark the path but make no sound, pressing my shape into the ground. What am I?
2025-10-14.hint: You leave me behind when you walk.

2025-10-15.riddle: I come from the sky but never fly, I strike with light yet vanish quick. What am I?
2025-10-15.hint: You see me flash before thunder follows.
